 Residents and craft enthusiasts will have an opportunity to create ocean-inspired resin artwork at Tackle Box Brewing in Marlborough on November 22. The two-hour workshop will teach participants how to make decorative charcuterie boards featuring ocean wave designs, with admission costing $65 per person. The event is scheduled for 1 to 3 p.m. at 416 Boston Post Road E.
 All materials and supplies needed to complete the project are included in the admission price, according to a community announcement reported by cwibc.co.id. Participants do not need previous crafting experience to attend. The session is designed to provide a hands-on opportunity to produce an individual resin board during the scheduled workshop.

 Reclaimed and Refined, a do-it-yourself craft studio based in Coventry, Rhode Island, is organizing the Marlborough event. The studio regularly arranges creative workshops at breweries, wineries, and restaurants across southern New England, according to the community announcement.

 The studio's events combine practical craft activities with hospitality venues. This format allows participants to work on individual creative projects while attending organized sessions at local businesses. For the Marlborough workshop, the featured project will be a charcuterie board decorated with an ocean wave effect using resin. The November 22 session will run for two hours, and the $65 admission fee covers the necessary materials.
